title: Hoi An in a day
summary: The covered bridge, Tan Ky House, the Fujian and Cantonese halls, the market, and cao lầu. An Bang is a separate half day.

stops.name: Japanese Covered Bridge
stops.note: Start at the west end and allow about 20 minutes. From 10 August 2026 the city fee is 20,000 VND per person per building. Combination tickets are still described at 80,000 VND and 120,000 VND.

approach.note: On foot from the lanes just off the old town.

stops.name: Tan Ky House
stops.note: See one old house, at 101 Nguyễn Thái Học. The visit is well under an hour.

approach.note: Walk the pedestrian streets to 101 Nguyễn Thái Học.

stops.name: Fujian Assembly Hall
stops.note: Walk the three courts of the Fujian hall at 46 Trần Phú.

stops.name: Cantonese Assembly Hall
stops.note: Walk the front court of the Cantonese hall, built in 1885.

approach.note: Walk on through the old town.

stops.name: Hoi An Market
stops.note: Eat under the market roof in the daytime.

approach.note: Walk to the yellow market hall.

stops.name: Cao lau
stops.note: Eat cao lầu in the old town.

additions.name: An Bang
additions.note: Sand and a swim. The beach is a separate half day from this old-town walk.

seoDescription: One day in Hoi An: the covered bridge, Tan Ky House, two assembly halls, the market, and cao lầu.
